I saved Marcus's preference to the gbrain memory: from 2026-10-14 on, his dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups is Bay 21. It's stored as a fact about him, with the source recorded as his direct message. The brain shows a fact from a DM only to the member who said it, so it won't come up in anyone else's conversations.

I also replied in his DM to confirm the note and that it stays between the two of us. He said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else.
